column3: With respect to the ExchangeRight Net Leased Portfolio #72 Mortgage Loan, as to the Dollar General-Johnstown, PA Mortgaged Property (0.1%), the ESA identified a CREC related to the former use of the Mortgaged Property for various industrial and commercial operations, including a gas station, a slaughterhouse and a cold storage facility, among other uses. A Phase II ESA performed in 2015 identified exceedances of applicable standards for several key contaminants, including lead and arsenic in soil samples and benzene in groundwater, among others. The Mortgaged Property was voluntarily enrolled in Pennsylvania’s Act 2 Voluntary Cleanup Program.
